title.narrative: Flood Management in Selected River Basins Sector Project

description.narrative: The project will support the Government of Indonesia and river-based communities in better managing and mitigating flood risks. The project has been designed as a sector loan to support the implementation of the Strategic Plan for Water Resources, 2015-2019 (SPWR) of the Ministry of Public Works and Housing (MPWH). The SPWR includes policy measures and priority investments in 63 river basin territories (RBTs) in Indonesia. The project will finance subprojects in the Cidanau-Ciujung-Cidurian (Banten province) and Ambon-Seram (Maluku province) RBTs. Project interventions will (i) enhance hydrometeorological data and analysis, management, and institutional coordination for managing flood risks; (ii) upgrade and develop flood protection infrastructure; (iii) improve watershed conditions to moderate runoff peaks and soil erosion; and (iv) prepare communities to manage floods. The project will promote effective flood risk management (FRM) by coupling infrastructure investment with supporting software measures. It will contribute to the achievement of the government's National Medium Term Development Plan, 2015-2019 (RPJMN) sector target to reduce the magnitude of economic and social damage due to floods.

description.narrative: Flood risks in selected river basins, including those in the Cidanau?-Ciujung?-Cidurian and Ambon?-Seram RBTs, reduced through FRM

About 19,000 ha of land with reduced flood risks Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Based on the realized five sub projects, designed sub projects, and the village area affected by the flood risk, the reduced flood risk in Ciujung-Cidanau-Cidurian and Ambon RBTs is 49,461 Ha and 32,225 buildings, which exceeded the target of 19,000 Ha and 22,000 households. It is noted that based on the realized five sub projects and the village area affected by the flood risk in Ciujung and Way Batu Merah rivers, the reduced flood risk is 10,826 Ha and 7,605 buildings.
The total simulated reduced flood risk area with flood return period of Q25 achieved at 15,833 ha (83%) against 19,000 ha outcome target indicator. Data Source: PPMS, project completion report Target value: 19,000 ha

About 22,000 households with reduced flood risks Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Based on the realized five sub projects, designed sub projects, and the village area affected by the flood risk, the reduced flood risk in Ciujung-Cidanau-Cidurian and Ambon RBTs is 49,461 Ha and 32,225 buildings, which exceeded the target of 19,000 Ha and 22,000 households. It is noted that based on the realized five sub projects and the village area affected by the flood risk in Ciujung and Way Batu Merah rivers, the reduced flood risk is 10,826 Ha and 7,605 buildings. Data Source: PPMS, project completion report Target value: 22,000 hh
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Capacity for CBFRM enhanced Indicator: 30 communities in the Ambon-Seram and Cidanau-Ciujung-Cidurian RBTs have access to information from flash flood localized early warning Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Achieved- exceeding the target indicator. A total of 140 disaster responsive community groups/KMSB (119 in 3Cis and 21 in Ambon-Seram) were established in 2020 by a village decree and trained for flood hazard mitigation and responses.
Data Source: MOHA reports, quarterly project reports, PPMS

Output: Capacity for CBFRM enhanced Indicator: At least 30% of those involved in the identification and design of community-level infrastructure and O&M are female Achievement: 29 Progress/Status: Achieved. From 527 people involved in identification, prioritization and design of community-level infrastructure, 299 (32%) woman participated in Pandeglang, 259 (40%) participants in Serang, and 406 (23%) participants in Lebak, and 170 (22%) participants in Ambon. Gender responsive disaster contingency plans will be formulated in Q2 2023.
Data Source: MOHA reports, quarterly project reports, PPMS

Output: Land management improved and flood infrastructure upgraded Indicator: 246 farmers groups trained on sustainable agricultural practices and watershed management Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Achieved- exceeding the target indicator. The total of 444 farmers groups (FGs) or 8,011 members were trained on sustainable agricultural practices in Districts: Serang (102 FGs), Lebak (223 FGs), and Pandeglang (119 FGs). Out of 8,011 members, Male are 6.867 (85.72%) and Female are 1.144 (14.28%).
The Participatory construction packages consist of village irrigation network construction 5,565 Ha, micro dams 68 packages, pond 36 packages, infiltration well 35 packages, pump irrigation 33 packages, Field Training Center 3 packages, farm road: 110 packages.
Data Source: MOA reports, quarterly project reports, PPMS

Output: Land management improved and flood infrastructure upgraded Indicator: 6,150 ha of land with improved management Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Partially achieved. The totalled of land management improved at 78.7% (4,841 hectares).
Of that, the land optimization reached at 47.35% (805 ha of the target 1,700 hectares). The total of 55 farm roads constructed. The land conservation area reached at 90.7% (4,036 ha of the target of 4,450 hectares). Under the ministry of agriculture (MOA) project components, it was challenging to find the suitable farmers' land for the planned land conservation and optimization activities.
The total trees planted reached at 333,145 or 44% of the PAM target 756,500 trees. Data Source: MOA reports, quarterly project reports, PPMS

Output: Planning for FRM enhanced Indicator: Hydrometeorological stations installed Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Achieved. Hydrometeorological networks equipment and Control Room The procurement of Hydrometeorological networks equipment for Ciujung (G1A1) and Ambon (G1B1) started in Q2 2021.
• G1B1 package was awarded on 8 December 2021. The physical progress was completed in Dec 2022 • G1A1 package was awarded on 21 April 2022. The physical progress was completed in September 2022. • One small package for the construction of the control room and Hydrometeorological stations in Ambon was signed on 21 Oct 2021. The control room construction (CW10) has been completed. • The Flood forecasting early warning system (FFEWS) consulting package in Ciujung (CS10) awarded on 3 July 2023 and Ambon (CS11) awarded on 19 July 2023. The implementation and operationalization of FFEWS has been completed in June 2024. Data Source: RBO hydrology reports, quarterly project reports, PPMS

Output: Planning for FRM enhanced Indicator: Hydrometeorological stations repaired Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Achieved. The repaired Hydrometeorological stations target and planning were revised according to the rationalization study conducted by engineering consultant during the project implementation.
Ciujung RBT: In Ciujung RBTs, the target is to build and repaired totalled 25 stations; consist of: (i) 21 new stations of Automatic Water Level Recorder (AWLR), (ii) 4 new stations of Automatic Weather Stations (AWS), and 1 CCTV location. Progress: The installation of stations in Ciujung was completed in December 2022. Provisional hand over was conducted on 31 January 2023.
Ambon RBT: In Ambon RBTs, the target is to build and rehabilitated of totalled 10 stations as follows: (i) build 2 new stations of Automatic Rainfall Recorder (ARR), 2 new stations of AWLR, and 2 stations of AWS; (ii) upgrade 2 stations of AWLR and 2 stations of AWSs and manual climatology, and (iii) install 6 new CCTV.
Progress: The installation of Hydrometeorological stations in Ambon have been completed in September 2022. Provisional Hand Over was conducted on 1 September 2022.
The construction of control room and station in Ambon have been successfully completed.
Data Source: RBO hydrology reports, quarterly project reports, PPMS

Output: Planning for FRM enhanced Indicator: Women account for at least 20% of those trained in flood risk assessment and analysis, CBFRM prioritization, and implementation of locally appropriate FRM measures Achievement: 40 Progress/Status: Achieved. The overall women participation has achieved 33.27%. About 2,119 (22.1%) women actively participated in the community groups for disaster preparedness (Komunitas Masyarakat Peduli Bencana/ KMSB) organization and 1,013 (40.2%) women participated in Waste Bank organization.
Data Source: Quarterly project reports, PPMS

Output: Land management improved and flood infrastructure upgraded Indicator: Flood protection infrastructure rehabilitated or upgraded as per FRMPs developed under 1c Achievement: N Progress/Status: Achieved.
Core Subprojects: Construction progress of the core subprojects has completed for CW01 and CW02 packages. Maintenance period completed on 25 September 2024
Non-core Subprojects: As of 30 September, the construction of the non-core subprojects has completed for Ciujung CW03 package in September 2024 with maintenance period until 30 September 2025. However, the construction will not be funded by the loan. DED for the six subprojects have been prepared.
